SELECT s.format, s.store_id < 900 AS physical, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, MIN(d.fiscal_week) wk0, MAX(d.fiscal_week) wk1, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id, s.format, cs.format AS cur_format, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, store_id, sale_date)) rc_keys,
 SUM(CASE WHEN format<>cur_format THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fmt_changed,
 SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) staff_rc,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) FILTER (WHERE false) x
FROM base

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period),
lines AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id, s.format, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
 CROSS JOIN params
 WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
   AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period)
SELECT 'mixed_receipts' AS k, COUNT(*) AS v, NULL AS v2 FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM lines GROUP BY 1 HAVING MIN(staff_purchase_flag::INT) <> MAX(staff_purchase_flag::INT))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctrl_before_returns_all_incl_staff', SUM(net_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt_control', SUM(net_sales_before_returns), SUM(receipts) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND r.store_id<900

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period)
SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 3
